Batch-export mirror plots for all compounds in a direct_match list

Source: R/MS1_MS2_mirror_plots.R
export_mirror_plots.Rd

Batch-export mirror plots for all compounds in a direct_match list

Usage

export_mirror_plots(
  input_list_ms1,
  input_list_ms2,
  annot_res_ms1,
  annot_res_ms2,
  out_dir = "mirror_plots",
  scale_method = "log10",
  mz_digits = 1,
  padding = 0.05,
  precursor_extra_frac = 0.04,
  shared_xlim = TRUE,
  mz_label_mode = "all",
  width = 6.5,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)

Arguments

input_list_ms1

List; direct_match_StM14_res_MS1

input_list_ms2

List; direct_match_StM14_res_MS2

annot_res_ms1

Data frame; StM14_annotate_res_ms1 (only annotation_phase == "Phase1" rows are used)

annot_res_ms2

Data frame; StM14_annotate_res_ms2 (only annotation_phase == "Phase1" rows are used)

out_dir

Output directory (created if absent)

scale_method

Intensity scale

mz_digits

Decimal places for m/z labels

padding

Fractional x-axis padding

precursor_extra_frac

Extra right-side padding for precursor marker

shared_xlim

Logical; share x-axis across MS1 and MS2 panels

mz_label_mode

One of "all", "primary", "adduct"

width

Plot width in inches

height

Plot height in inches

dpi

Resolution for PNG output

Value

Invisibly, a list of per-compound output paths
